wholePhysicalScope: Exact mapped outline of the fort building cross-referenced against the captioned NPS exterior photographs, National Historic Landmark building record, and unchanged terrain.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open courtyard, projecting bastions, gates, staircases and red commandant’s quarters.
limitations: Standing fort building only. The separately situated former stables, lower seaside outwork and movable displays are outside the mapped building boundary. Fine masonry, woodwork and smaller openings are approximated.
